const chat = await t.run(async (ctx) => ctx.db.get('chats', chatId))
// `chats.send` always stamps the thread; a missing chat is a broken harness, and
// an empty threadId would silently read an empty thread and fail every assertion
// below with "no rows" instead of naming the real cause.
if (chat === null) throw new Error(`chats.send returned a chat id with no chat row: ${chatId}`)
// A single send fans out a handful of scheduled jobs; take a bounded page well
// above that rather than collecting the whole system table.
return { rows: messages.page as unknown as ThreadRow[], streamJobState: streamJob?.state.kind }
